anchors.quote: Pinned Catala coalesces identical literal consequences; different overlapping consequences raise conflict. RuleIR returns CONFLICT for two applicable exceptions even when their values are identical.

interpretation: Compute the declared outputs for the supplied primitive inputs.
source:
```catala
scope Control:
  label baseRule definition result equals 0
  exception baseRule definition result under condition first consequence equals 1
  exception baseRule definition result under condition second consequence equals 2
```
